treeMemory.info.en: Automatically remembers folder expansion and collapse choices for this repository and restores them next time. Clear them in Settings → Local cache.
treeMemory.info.zh-CN: 自动记住此仓库的目录展开与收缩状态，下次打开时恢复。可在「设置 → 本地缓存」中清理。

treeMemory.introduction.en: Folder expansion and collapse choices are remembered automatically for your next visit.
treeMemory.introduction.zh-CN: 将自动记住目录的展开与收缩状态，方便下次打开时恢复。

treeMemory.unavailable.en: Folder expansion cache is unavailable; temporary browsing remains available.
treeMemory.unavailable.zh-CN: 目录展开缓存不可用，仍可临时浏览。

treeMemory.hintUnavailable.en: Unable to save or read this tip’s dismissal. Retry to remember your choice.
treeMemory.hintUnavailable.zh-CN: 无法读取或保存提示的关闭状态，请重试以记住此选择。
